data.gender_notes: Bergmans is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic elements berg meaning mountain, and mann meaning man. This name signifies a strong and sturdy individual, who is connected to nature and has a deep sense of self-reliance and independence. The name Bergmans carries the meaning “Mountain man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bergmans usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to be blessed by the mountain spirits and carries a deep connection to the earth and nature. It is a name that inspires strength, courage, and a strong sense of self.
